response.text: The "single" test fails because `"7".split("-")` returns `["7"]` — there's no `to` element, so it becomes `undefined` and `Number(undefined)` is `NaN`. Fix by defaulting `to` to `from` when the range has no hyphen:

input.find:
const [from, to] = text.split("-");
  return { from: Number(from), to: Number(to) };
